newsitem.title: CANADA: Bema rebounds in heavy trading.
newsitem.headline: Bema rebounds in heavy trading.

text.p: Bema Gold Corp was caught in a flurry of trading Thursday, recovering some of its losses from Wednesday.
The stock was up C$0.45 to C$10.35 by midday Thursday on volume of more than 1.1 million shares.
On Wednesday, Bema lost C$0.55 to close at C$9.90.
"It's on the rebound," said John Ing, gold analyst at Maison Placements Canada. "It's been under pressure since the last round of results."
The stock has traded heavily since it released drill results from its Cerro Casale deposit last week.
Investors are shuffling their positions as they try to digest the results and await further news, analysts said.
"You're seeing a lot of trading because there's still a long period of time to go before the necessary facts come to light," said another analyst.
"People just don't know, and when that happens you get a lot of speculative trading."
